summary: You can take admins out of PIM Manager or bring existing ones in, and manage Administrative Units from Drift and Discovery.

new.title: Stop managing an admin
new.text: On Admin accounts or the Access map, Stop managing takes an admin out of PIM Manager. Nothing changes in Entra ID; use Mark for manual removal to also remove the access.

new.title: Import admins PIM Manager does not manage
new.text: Admin accounts now lists admin accounts that exist in the directory but not in PIM Manager. Import stages the admin and the access they hold today for Review & commit.

new.title: Keep Administrative Units from Drift
new.text: An Administrative Unit found in the tenant but not in PIM Manager can now be kept from the Drift page. PIM Manager never deletes an Administrative Unit.

new.title: Administrative Units in Discovery
new.text: New Administrative Units appear in Discovery, and Create stages their definition.

new.title: Create an Administrative Unit card
new.text: A new card defines an Administrative Unit and can give a group Entra roles inside it. Giving a group Entra roles can now be limited to chosen units.

fixes.title: Import administrators accepts its own example
fixes.text: Import administrators now accepts the format its example shows: sign-in name, display name and department, without a header line.
